fields.summary_ko.0: Visa Inc. V is expanding its 'Agentic Ready' program for AI agent-based commerce, with over 140 participating companies (Adyen, Fiserv, PayPal, Stripe, etc.) participating at launch.
fields.summary_ko.1: If AI-driven purchasing gains momentum, new revenue opportunities through payment processing and ancillary services could emerge, though near-term revenue contribution is expected to depend on transaction volume generation.
fields.summary_ko.2: Competitors such as Mastercard MA's Agent Connect and American Express AXP's ACE Developer Kit are developing similar solutions, making early standard-setting important for competitive advantage.
